sentences.en: My fingers pronounce every word, every pause and every accent.
sentences.zh: 我的手指清晰地表达出每一个词语、每一个停顿和每一个重音。

sentences.en: There was a brief pause and then the music began.
sentences.zh: 短暂的沉默之后，音乐开始了。

sentences.en: Sami was sitting on the couch with the TV paused.
sentences.zh: 萨米坐在沙发上，电视画面暂停了。
